title: Down to Business with CB gives insight into the worklives of some of beauty’s biggest names
summary: Cosmetics Business’ new quickfire Q&A series, Down to Business with CB, sees beauty industry icons, such as Trinny London’s Trinny Woodall, JVN Hair’s Jonathan Van Ness and Tropic Skincare’s Susie Ma, give an unfiltered insight into their roles as brand founders

extraction.key_fact: 코스메틱스 비즈니스가 뷰티 업계 창립자들의 업무와 역할을 조명하는 신규 인터뷰 시리즈를 선보인다.
